locators.title: Waldschmidt, Linear independence of logarithms of algebraic numbers
locators.locator: Introduction p.ii, lines51–53; Chapter3 Heights–Liouville inequality

summary: Waldschmidt explicitly identifies the elementary rational estimate by a denominator as a Liouville estimate. Stacks supplies abstract localization context, not the archimedean lower bound. The exact coordinatewise multidegree statement is supported by local clean.tex §7 eq54.
